In the service blueprint, **Discovery** is a `scenario` under the `Application` `phase` on the `Standard` `path` (the live `happy` path). It maps how prospective college tutors discover the program, submit an interest form, and attend a required screening info session.

I checked the live service blueprint rows for Discovery just now, so this accurately reflects how the recruitment journey operates today.

---

### Step 1: `Discovers PLUS`
Candidates discover PLUS across five parallel recruitment channels, all of which funnel into the same interest form:

* **`Regular Tutor` (Candidate):**
  * Discovers PLUS through one of five entry points: [word of mouth](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070103), [social media](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070203), the [PLUS marketing website](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070303), [on-campus activities](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070403), or [Handshake job postings](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070503).
* **`Front Stage Actions`:**
  * [Current or former PLUS tutors](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070104) share word-of-mouth recommendations with prospective tutors.
  * The [tutor supervisor team](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070404) staffs on-campus job fairs to answer questions in person.
* **`Front Stage Touchpoints`:**
  * [Posters & job fair booths](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070406) on university campuses.
  * [Social Media](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070206) posts on Instagram and LinkedIn.
  * The [Marketing Website](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070306) (`tutors.plus`), routing candidates via "Become a Tutor" or "Try Demo".
  * [Handshake](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070506) employer job listings.
* **`Back Stage Actions` & `Back Stage Touchpoints`:**
  * Tutor supervisors post and manage openings via the [Handshake employer profile](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070507) using semester student-ratio forecasts.
  * Design and Dev collaborate on marketing copy and implementation via [Figma and web tooling](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070308).
  * Marketing manages [social media campaigns](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070207).

---

### Step 2: `Interested in joining PLUS`
This step captures inbound candidate interest without granting full applicant status:

* **`Regular Tutor`:**
  * [Submits the interest form](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000070603) via the website or Handshake. Crucially, submitting this form is **not** yet an application—candidates must attend an info session before receiving the official application form.
* **`Front Stage Touchpoints`:**
  * [Google Form](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000616) used to gather candidate contact information and availability.

---

### Step 3: `Attends info session`
The info session acts as the actual screening gate for the entire application funnel:

* **`Regular Tutor`:**
  * [Attends the required PLUS info session](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000611). Only verified attendees receive the post-info-session application form, which doubles as the first interview round.
* **`Front Stage Actions`:**
  * The [tutor supervisor team hosts the info session](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000613) and distributes the post-session application form directly to attendees.
* **`Front Stage Touchpoints`:**
  * [Zoom](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000612) video conference room.
* **`Back Stage Actions`:**
  * The [tutor supervisor team maintains slides and tracks attendance](https://uno-blueprint.netlify.app/?cell=e0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000614). Attendance tracking is strictly enforced—unverified attendance terminates the funnel before any interview takes place.
